answer: One Sybil defense is a crystal-clear bonding rule: every new identity must lock a stake that slowly cools like an ember, unlocking only after several epochs of peer-verified work. A clone farm can't just whisper a hundred fake names into the jury pool; each puppet ties up its own capital and compute for weeks, and any one caught copying or colluding forfeits its bond, so faking scale costs far more than it can earn.
